# Claude Code Plugins: Marketplace

A marketplace is a `marketplace.json` file that lists plugins and where to get them.
A team can host one so that each member installs the same plugins.
For example, `claude plugin marketplace add owner/repo` adds a marketplace from a GitHub repo.
The marks are explained on [Plugins](Claude-Code-Plugins).

## Top-Level Keys

File: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.
An unknown key is ignored and `validate` warns.

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `name` | Marketplace id. | Letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`. Many reserved names (official, `inline`, `builtin`, `skills-dir`, `synced`, `npm`, `github`, `claudeai-` prefix, JavaScript member names). | marketplace.json | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `owner` | Maintainer. | `name` required, `email`, `url`. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Host and Maintain a Marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/host-marketplace) |
| ✅ | `plugins` | Entries. | An invalid entry becomes a stub with source `unsupported`. Others still load. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Commands Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `$schema`, `description`, `version` | Info. | `metadata.description` and `metadata.version` are alternates. | marketplace.json | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `metadata.pluginRoot` | Base for bare source names. | v2.1.239 or later. Must be inside the marketplace. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `forceRemoveDeletedPlugins` | Uninstalls removed plugins. | Boolean. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Host and Maintain a Marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/host-marketplace) |
| ✅ | `allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn` | Allowed dependency marketplaces. | Array of names. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Host and Maintain a Marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/host-marketplace) |
| ✅ | `renames` | Old name to new name or `null`. | Append-only map. | marketplace.json | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Host and Maintain a Marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/host-marketplace) |

## Plugin Entry Keys

An entry also accepts every `plugin.json` key except the directory listing fields.
See [Manifest](Claude-Code-Plugins-Manifest).

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `name`, `source` | Required id and place. | The entry name is what users type before `@`. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `category`, `tags` | Catalog data. | Free text. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `strict` | Manifest authority. | Default `true`. With `false` and a `plugin.json`, component keys in the entry cause `conflicting manifests`. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `headers`, `headersHelper` | Archive download headers. | v2.1.238 or later. `headersHelper` needs `strict: false`. Only for `archive`. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `defaultEnabled`, `displayName`, `dependencies`, `metadata` | As in the manifest. | Entry values override for display and `defaultEnabled`. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `relevance` | When to suggest the plugin. | `topic` (64 characters) and `signals`: `cli`, `hosts`, `filesRead`, `manifestDeps` (`file` + `pattern`), `cwd`. Each list has limits (10 or 20). Needs setting `pluginSuggestionMarketplaces`. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Manage Claude Code Plugins for Your Organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org) |
| ✅ | `experimental` in an entry | Component declarations. | Validate warns when it is not an object. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Plugin Commands Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference) |

## Plugin Sources

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | Relative path string | A folder in the marketplace. | Starts with `./`, no `..`, no backslash. Bare name only under `metadata.pluginRoot`. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `github` | `repo`, `ref`, `sha`. | `sha` is 40 lowercase hex. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Commands Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `url` | `url`, `ref`, `sha`. | A git URL. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `git-subdir` | `url`, `path`, `ref`, `sha`. | Sparse, partial clone. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `npm` | `package`, `version`, `registry`. | Install scripts never run. Git, file, and alias specs refused. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `archive` | `url`, `sha256`. | HTTPS zip. v2.1.224 or later. | entry | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `command` | `command`, `timeout` (1 to 600, default 60), `mode` (`copy` or `link`). | Prints one absolute path. 500 characters at most. Copy limit 256 MiB or 20,000 entries. Link not on Windows. Off with `disableCommandPluginSources`. | entry | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| 🔍 | `unsupported` | Placeholder source. | Made by the parser. An author cannot write it. | entry | bundle |

## Marketplace Sources

Used by `extraKnownMarketplaces`, `strictKnownMarketplaces`, `blockedMarketplaces`.

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `github` | `repo`, `ref`, `path`, `sparsePaths`. | `owner/*` only in policy lists. | all three | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Commands Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `git` | `url`, `ref`, `path`, `sparsePaths`. | `skipLfs` is accepted and ignored. | all three | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Commands Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `url` | `url`, `headers`, `headersHelper`. | Fetches only the JSON file, so no relative sources. | all three | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `file`, `directory` | `path`. | Read in place. | all three | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `settings` | `name`, `plugins`, `owner`. | Inline catalog. Entries need remote sources. | extraKnownMarketplaces | [Plugin Manifest Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference), [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference) |
| ✅ | `npm` | `package`. | Fails to load: "NPM marketplace sources not yet implemented". | policy lists parse it | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
| ✅ | `skills-dir`, `hostPattern`, `pathPattern` | Policy-only values. | `skills-dir` keeps skills-directory plugins loading under an allowlist. Patterns are regular expressions. | policy lists | [Marketplace Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference), [Plugin Loading Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading) |
